tryit.title: Try it
tryit.intro: Choose a sample design to see it woven.
tryit.confirmReplace: Your scanned cards are not saved. Replace them with this sample?
print.scale: Print at 100% scale, do not fit to page.
print.notCut: This is a print for photographing. It is not a cut card and cannot be used on a loom.
profile.name: Card profile:
notice.unverifiedProfile: The values of this card profile are not measured from a real card.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.profile.banner: The card profile could not be used. You can still move between screens.
error.sim.invalid-profile: The card profile is not valid, so the cloth cannot be shown. Check the profile file.
error.sim.invalid-settings: One of the cloth choices is not allowed. The last cloth is still shown. Change the choice and try again.
error.sim.pick-out-of-range: That pick does not exist. Choose a pick between the first and the last.
error.profile.fetch-failed: The card profile file could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
error.profile.not-json: The card profile file is damaged and cannot be read. Replace it with a good copy.
error.profile.invalid-profile: The card profile has wrong or missing values. Correct the profile file.
error.print.invalid-card: This card cannot be printed because the profile or the card holes are not valid. Nothing was downloaded.
error.export.invalid-profile: The card profile is not valid, so no file was made. Check the profile file and try again.
error.export.invalid-card: One or more cards are damaged, so no file was made. Scan those cards again and try again.
error.export.empty-pattern: There is no design to save as a file. Pick a sample in Try it or scan a card first.
error.export.invalid-options: One of the file choices is not allowed, so no file was made. Change the choice and try again.
error.bmpRead.invalid-profile: The card profile is not valid, so the file cannot be read. Check the profile file.
error.bmpRead.invalid-options: One of the file choices is not allowed, so the file cannot be read. Change the choice and try again.
error.bmpRead.not-a-bmp: This is not a BMP file. Choose a file that Naqsha saved.
error.bmpRead.unsupported-bmp: This kind of BMP file is not supported. Choose a file that Naqsha saved.
error.bmpRead.inconsistent-size: The file is damaged or cut short. Choose another copy of the file.
error.bmpRead.width-mismatch: The file does not fit this card profile: it has a different number of ends. Choose the matching card profile or another file.
error.bmpRead.unknown-colour: The file has a colour that is not a lift or no lift. Choose a file that Naqsha saved.
error.archive.not-found: That saved design was not found. It may already be deleted. Check the list.
error.archive.storage-unavailable: Saved designs cannot be reached in this browser right now. Your design is still here. Check that the browser allows site storage and try again.
error.archive.write-failed: The design could not be saved. What you typed is kept. Try again.
error.read.invalid-profile: The card layout file is not valid, so the card cannot be read. See the details below, then choose a correct card layout file.
error.read.invalid-image: This file could not be used as an image. Choose a photo file, such as JPG or PNG, and try again.
error.read.peg-holes-not-found: The two large alignment holes were not found. Place the whole card in the photo on a plain background and try again.
error.read.ambiguous-orientation: The direction of the card could not be decided. Take the photo again with the card flat and lit evenly.
error.read.resolution-too-low: The holes are too small in the photo. Move closer or use a larger photo, then try again.
error.read.card-outside-image: Part of the card is outside the photo. Move the phone back so the whole card fits, then try again.
